findings.issue: getRealChangedFiles() only runs git diff --name-only, so untracked newly-created files are invisible. That creates a false-green path: a stage can create an untracked file, declare no_code_change:true, and verifyReceipts() will pass because realChanged is empty. This violates FR-RECEIPT-001/002 and F9 because receipt verification can miss real worktree changes.
findings.recommendation: Collect untracked files too, e.g. combine git diff --name-only with git ls-files --others --exclude-standard, or fail-loud when untracked files exist. Update diff_sha semantics/tests so newly-created untracked files cannot be hidden by no_code_change:true.

findings.issue: appendTaskIndex() performs a read-modify-write directly against ~/.workflowhub/task-index.json with writeFileSync(). This is non-atomic: concurrent appends can lose one record, and a partial write can corrupt the existing index. Structural Quality Gate marks non-atomic multi-step state updates with possible half-write as blocking.
findings.recommendation: Write through an atomic temp-file + rename path, and add a concurrency/changed-underfoot guard or lock/retry strategy. Add regression coverage for concurrent append or stale-read overwrite, plus partial/corrupt write handling.

findings.issue: Phase 2 scope T004-T009 remains unchecked in the authoritative tasks.md even though the review package claims Phase 2 foundational is ready. The review contract requires current phase tasks to be checked for delivery completeness.
findings.recommendation: After fixing the code findings, mark T004-T009 complete in tasks.md or provide an explicit, reviewable reason why this phase intentionally leaves them unchecked.

resolutionSummary: Targeted Phase 2 tests and full regression both pass locally, and evidence files have sane exit codes/timestamps with no placeholder markers. Blocking remains on receipt false-green for untracked files, non-atomic task-index writes, and Phase 2 task completion state not recorded.
